reading_measurement.policy: Native semantic pupil paragraphs and table-body prompts per slide, printed page and route. Excludes titles, route/column headings, blank response lines, name/date fields, evidence and accreditation labels, legal credit, staff-only directions and calendar metadata. Logical paragraph and explicit line breaks are retained; visual wrapping does not add sentences. English word tokens exclude numbers. FK grade = 0.39 words/fragments + 11.8 syllables/words − 15.59; screening age = FK grade + 5. This is a heuristic screen, not a learner assessment. Technical terms are pre-taught and read aloud.
